Below the lg breakpoint the sidebar is a drawer opened by the button above. Tab reaches it, Enter or Space opens it, Tab cycles the items inside, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button.

At lg and up the sidebar is permanent chrome and the button is irrelevant; the header toggle collapses it to an icon rail instead.

A link outside the drawer — focus must not reach it while the drawer is open.
